task_description: Implements a cyclic accumulation algorithm that computes the cumulative sum of integers from 1 to n. By maintaining two variables to track the current integer and the accumulated result, it ultimately ensures the postcondition k + i + j >= 2 * n is satisfied. The program includes correctness verification of loop invariants.
method_signature: method main(n: int, k: int) returns (i :int, j: int)

test_cases.test_1:
var i1, j1 := main(0, 1);
assert k + i1 + j1 >= 2 * n;
test_cases.test_2:
var i2, j2 := main(3, 1);
assert k + i2 + j2 >= 2 * n;
test_cases.test_3:
var i3, j3 := main(5, 0);
assert k + i3 + j3 >= 2 * n;
